title: Tenant protection plan.
officialText:
When alteration, partial alteration, or construction operations are performed at occupied multiple dwellings, the department shall periodically verify compliance with a tenant protection plan as provided for in Chapter 1 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code and Section 3303.10.
*Section 1704.33 was added by Local Law 116 of 2019. This law has an effective date of March 8, 2020.

RESISTANCE
